primitives.name: Support Route State Transition
primitives.verbatim_quote: - parent_id: BUILD-CMD-026 - dependency_ids: none ## Category support/customer success ## Goal Support routes route confused users, billing users, and risk-sensitive users to clear next steps.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'U': 'User state vector (confused, billing, risk-sensitive)', 'S': 'Support route (contact, faq, pricing)', 'T': 'Transition function'}
primitives.assumptions: User states are mutually exclusive and fully observable; transitions are deterministic within defined boundaries.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When U is undefined or T is non-compliant with legal boundaries.

layer2.mapping: Support routing mirrors a Markov decision process where each route is a state-action pair with reward based on user resolution.
layer2.telemetry: User path completion rate, escalation frequency, compliance adherence.

primitives.name: Behavior Verification Boundary
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Real App Evidence Route verification shows pages exist, but support workflows are not launch-proved.
primitives.assumptions: Verification requires empirical testing; R implies B, but L is conditional on B.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When B is unverifiable due to missing test data or live-link exposure.

layer2.mapping: Verification kernel computes launch readiness by combining route existence with behavioral validation metrics.
layer2.telemetry: Test coverage ratio, route probe success rate, data leakage indicators.

primitives.name: Compliance Constraint Function
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Legal / Compliance Boundary Do not expose founder-only methodology, live affiliate links, live prizes, or billing changes without explicit approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C': 'Compliance constraint set', 'M': 'Methodology exposure level', 'L': 'Live link presence (boolean)', 'P': 'Prize visibility (boolean)', 'B': 'Billing change visibility (boolean)'}
primitives.assumptions: C is a closed set of rules; any violation of C results in immediate constraint activation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When any element of {M, L, P, B} exceeds threshold without approval.

layer2.mapping: Compliance function acts as a binary classifier over exposed elements, returning valid/invalid based on rule set.
layer2.telemetry: Approval log entries, exposure event count, constraint breach flags.
